signals_instruction: Important emails include: 1) Emails addressed to Rishikesh or mentioning Rishikesh in the body. 2) Security alerts from Google or admin notices. 3) Academic circulars, fee notifications, hostel dues, exam schedules (ST-II), and project evaluation rubrics from Chitkara University or BridgeLabz. 4) Deadlines, payments, invoices, or action-required items. Mark newsletters and promotional emails as low priority.
